product_updates.title: Cursor capitalizes on GitHub frustration, launches rival hosting platform
product_updates.content: Cursor, known for its AI Code Editor, is launching a new code-hosting platform to rival developers' long preferred favorite, GitHub.

product_updates.title: OpenAI institutes new safeguards after Hugging Face breach
product_updates.content: The new safeguards include more detailed monitoring of models during the development process, as well as greater emphasis on alignment and security during the post-training process.

product_updates.title: Etched’s valuation doubles to $21B in a month
product_updates.content: Jane Street has installed Etched's first shipped AI cluster system, and was so impressed, it led another massive round, the startup says.

product_updates.title: Why Apple’s camera-equipped AirPods may not be the ‘pervert pods’ consumers fear
product_updates.content: Apple’s leaked camera-equipped AirPods might avoid the privacy pitfalls of other AI wearables by preventing users from recording photos and videos.

product_updates.title: Warp’s new system is an out-of-the-box software factory for AI development
product_updates.content: On Tuesday, Warp introduced Warp Factories, a new infrastructure system designed to make building AI software factories as easy as possible.

product_updates.title: OpenAI launches a safer ChatGPT for teens — years after teens started using it
product_updates.content: ChatGPT for Teens adds age-appropriate safety measures, parental controls, and learning tools designed to steer teens away from harmful content — and from using AI to cheat on their homework.

product_updates.title: Perplexity’s free AI offer left it with millions more users in India
product_updates.content: Perplexity's India revenue rose about 60% after the Airtel offer ended for new users, even as downloads declined.

technical_breakthroughs.title: Microsoft Copilot reveals secret input that allowed it to be hacked
technical_breakthroughs.content: Secret parameter allowed hackers to steal passwords when a target clicked on a link.
